Class BukkitConfigNode

java.lang.Object
io.github.kaivian.klibrary.config.BukkitConfigNode
All Implemented Interfaces:
ConfigNode
public class BukkitConfigNode extends Object implements ConfigNode
A ConfigNode implementation backed by Bukkit's ConfigurationSection.

This adapter wraps Bukkit's native YAML configuration API, providing a format-agnostic view of YAML configuration data. This is the default implementation used when loading configuration from plugin.yml or any Bukkit FileConfiguration.

Example usage:

ConfigurationSection section = config.getConfigurationSection("actions");
ConfigNode node = new BukkitConfigNode(section);
String type = node.getString("type", "message");

    • getNodeList

      public List<ConfigNode> getNodeList(String key)
      Retrieves a list of child configuration nodes at the given key.

      This is used for configuration entries that contain a list of objects, such as a list of action definitions or requirement definitions.

      For Bukkit configurations, list-of-objects is represented as either a list of Maps (from getMapList()) or as numbered subsections. This implementation supports both patterns.

      Specified by:
      getNodeList in interface ConfigNode
      Parameters:
      key - the configuration key
      Returns:
      a list of child ConfigNodes, or an empty list if absent
